prompt: Create an original 150 second pastoral acoustic instrumental composition for nature documentary, landscape and gentle exploration. Mood: organic, open, fresh. Instruments: concert harp, flute, viola. Style: rolling harp figures and long woodwind answers. Tempo approximately 68 BPM; D dorian. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Introduce a gently rising motif and a sense of open air. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:50] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:50-01:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:40-02:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:30.

description.en: A gentle and melodic instrumental piece featuring a clear, high-pitched wind instrument (flute/recorder-like) playing the main melody, accompanied by a string ensemble. The music evokes a calm and somewhat classical or folk atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首轻柔而旋律优美的纯音乐，以清晰、高音的管乐器（类似长笛/竖笛）演奏主旋律，并由弦乐合奏伴奏。音乐营造出一种平静、略带古典或民间风格的氛围。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
